title: Information for Parents about Preschools' Safety Violations and Enforcement Action Records
what_it_is: Information for Parents about Preschools' Safety Violations and Enforcement Action Records

sections.label: Preschool enforcement and parent information
sections.summary: ECDA takes firm action on regulatory breaches, requires incident reporting, and says parents can check licence tenure.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: In cases of a regulatory breaches, ECDA will not hesitate to take firm action against errant operators.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: This may include revoking the preschool's licence where breaches are severe and systemic, or when the preschool can no longer provide services in a manner that is safe for children.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Under the Early Childhood Development Centres Act and Regulations, preschools are also required to notify parents immediately when there is a serious incident or illness that affects their child, and to also report such incidents to ECDA.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: ECDA has released statements regarding incidents of serious safety violations in preschools and the corresponding enforcement actions taken.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: However, ECDA does not generally name the preschools, to ensure that the identities of children involved are protected, especially in cases where gag orders are imposed in court proceedings.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: Parents can make informed decisions about preschools by considering the centre's licence tenure, which all preschools are required to display at a prominent location that is accessible to the public and which is also available on LifeSG platforms.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Social and Family Development (Mr Goh Pei Ming) (for the Minister for Social and Family Development)
sentences.text: For example, a 24-month licence indicates that a centre has met all key licensing requirements, while a six-month licence indicates that the centre has several areas for improvement.

sections.label: 2023 incident and gag order
sections.summary: The Minister lacks details of the 2023 incident and says information is typically not shared when a gag order applies.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: I think the question that the Member has raised is specific to the 2023 incident.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: I do not have the details of the incident and cannot respond to this case.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: If it is in the interest of all parents and the public to know about the incident, and the Court has not imposed a gag order, we will make a deliberate decision whether or not to release such information.

sentences.speaker: Mr Goh Pei Ming
sentences.text: But in this case, like what the Member has mentioned, there was a gag order and therefore, in such cases, we will typically not share information.
